channel.title: IT services · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on IT services in Indian markets. Today: strong tailwind (+3.3).

item.title: [+3] Rupee falls 10 paise to 96.45 against US dollar ahead of RBI monetary policy decision
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 23 reports from BusinessLine, Upstox, CNBC TV18 and 18 more. Related: “Rupee edges lower against dollar ahead of RBI policy decision”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 6 Oct).

IT services: strong tailwind (+3) — IT exporters earn more in rupees

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] India among top 10 emerging markets in AI readiness; private AI investment triples: World Bank
item.description:
Signal: strong tech and AI spending. 5 reports from India Weekly, Investment Guru India, BW Businessworld and 2 more. Related: “India Among Top 10 AI-Ready Markets As Investment Hits $4.1 Bn In 2025: World Bank”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 1 Oct).

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — More digital and AI deals

Why it matters: Rising global tech and AI budgets add deals for Indian IT services firms and power demand for data centres.

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Dollar index slips below 102 as euro and Aussie rise, oil falls ahead of Fed minutes
item.description:
Signal: a weaker dollar. 3 reports from VT Markets, www.tmgm.com, TradingView. Related: “US Dollar Index slips from its 18-month high”. Turn: earlier readings (2 Oct) pointed the other way.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Dollar earnings worth less

Why it matters: A softer dollar eases pressure on the rupee and draws foreign money back to emerging markets.

Market gauges: Rupee +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
